score_scale: 1 (weak) to 5 (strong) for Built2Bid; for content_cost and competitive_pressure, 5 = cheap / low pressure

audience_quality: People who type "roofing estimate template" or "contractor bid software" self-select as contractors; homeowner searches ("roof estimate cost") must be blocked with negative keywords.
purchase_intent: The query states the job to be done. Highest intent of any channel.
expected_cac: Computed from the funnel model (F01-F06) against LTV.
content_cost: Text ads plus the 11 existing trade landing pages; no video needed.
measurability: GA4 tag is live and sign_up can be imported into Google Ads as a key event (owner steps in META_GA4_SETUP.md); first-touch UTM cookie feeds /admin/marketing. Not 5: the link is not set up yet and paid subscriptions need server-side upload.
competitive_pressure: Established contractor-software vendors are expected to bid on generic software terms; not researched this phase [G203].
evidence_confidence: Cost and conversion anchors are recent, US, large-sample medians but from other advertisers [CE012] [CE013]; no contractor-software keyword data yet.

opportunity: Trade landing pages, guides and FAQ JSON-LD already exist; "how to price a deck/estimate template" content compounds and is free per click.

layers.total_platform_adoption: Not reported by Pew for search engines; treated as near-universal [INF].
layers.construction_industry_adoption: Not measured by any source found [G201].

layers.reachable_ad_audience: Unknown until a reach estimate is pulled in the ad tool (free, no spend) [G202]. Keyword Planner monthly searches and CPC forecasts replace this (X01).
layers.qualified_lead_generation: Model output per budget scenario (report 03); assumption-driven.
layers.customer_conversion_likelihood: Model: highest of the paid channels per click (F03, F05), still unproven.

profile.ad_formats: Responsive search ads; sitelinks; Performance Max (not recommended for a first test because it mixes placements) [INF].

profile.organic_opportunities: SEO on /bids/[trade] pages and guides; Google Business Profile is not relevant (Built2Bid is not a local service).

profile.restrictions: Standard Google Ads policies; no special category. Must not use competitor trademarks in ad text.
